sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for research steps
sections.what: Brings in the tools for search, live provider checks, page capture and source registration.
sections.why: The schema below records the results of these steps.
sections.watch_out: The live provider check can contact outside search services, so running it has a cost and a network effect.

sections.name: methodologyResearchSchema
sections.title: Schema for the methodology record
sections.what: Defines the stored record: a title and summary, the links used, a register of each source with its status and a passage, the queries run, qualification notes, and a health verdict for each provider. Includes a flag for fallback runs.
sections.why: Likely reason: to keep a written record of how the research was done. The code does not state this.
sections.watch_out: Source status is limited to captured or inaccessible, and provider verdicts are plain text that is not checked.

sections.name: researchMethodology
sections.title: Searches industry methodology sources
sections.what: Searches the web for lessons-learned and delivery literature for each chosen industry (one to six), captures the readable sources, and returns a register of them. Throws an error when no working web search provider is available or no accessible source is found, so no report is produced.
sections.why: The comment says industry literature is a separate register: it can inform method but never proves a project fact or changes the project record.
sections.watch_out: Providers that fail their health check are dropped and only noted in the qualification list, so coverage can be thinner than it looks.

summary: Defines the stored record for a research methodology: what was searched, which sources were captured or inaccessible, and how each search provider performed.
purpose: Keeps a checkable written account of how the research was done.
why: Likely reason: an auditable record of research steps. The code does not state this.
how: Imports the search, provider-check, capture and registration tools. Defines the record schema. The functions that fill it in are not visible in this packet.
inputs: Only the record's shape is visible. The inputs to the functions are not shown.
outputs: A checked methodology record, or a validation error.
risks: The provider verdict and the summary are free text with no fixed values. A source can only be marked captured or inaccessible, so an excluded source cannot be shown here.
debug: If a record fails validation, read the error for the field name. Common causes are a missing field or a URL that is not valid.
